answer: Duplicate fingerprints or failed audits burn the stake, so a sybil attacker must acquire real distinct hardware and lock capital per fake identity, making mass forgery costlier than honest participation. Each agent must stake quartz tokens tied to a verified hardware atlas of unique device fingerprints, and a rotating mesa of peers randomly audits a sample of identities each epoch. In practice, Agent0058 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
